artworks.title: The Crucifixion [verso]
artworks.description: The image shows a medieval-style illustration with three figures. In the center, a bearded figure with eyes closed, wearing a crown of thorns and a cloth around the waist, is on a cross with outstretched arms. On the left, a person in a robe with a halo holds a book. On the right, another figure in a robe and halo with a hat holds an open book. The illustration features a red and beige color scheme, intricate scrollwork, and decorative foliage patterns, with a parchment-like background.

artworks.title: The Marriage; the Kiss of the Bride (initial P); the Bride Abandoned (initial D)
artworks.description: This is a page from a book, with two tall columns of black text following a rectangular scene at the upper left corner, which shows a crowd under a balcony. Painted on vellum, the page also has a deocrated capital P and D, and a few other markings in cobalt blue and scarlet red. All the people in the scenes have pale skin. Most of the women wear crowns over long, braided hair. Their long dresses and the men's tunics and robes are painted in shades of azure or sky blue, crimson red, or pine green. In the rectangular illustration at the top left, a crowd of more than a dozen people gather closely around a man wearing a scarlet-red tunic, hood, and stockings, putting a gold ring on the hand of a woman wearing a shell-pink dress and a translucent veil under her crown. Two men to our right blow long horns, a man in front of them bends over to strike a pair of drums, and a woman to our left plays an instrument like a violin. Five people peek over the edge of a balcony above the crowd in front of a shining gold background. Below this scene, the man and woman are shown from the waist up within the round form of the captial letter P. They kiss and embrace against a vibrant blue background. In the D below, which resembles an O with an elongated apostrophe at the top, a woman with brown hair, wearing a garment that is half red and half green, holds a hand to her chest, her lips parted. The other hand rests on the bottom of the opening within the D. The tightly spaced text, next to the P and D, extends down to the bottom of the column and the right column is entirely text. About halfway down the right column, a smaller capital P is picked out with blue against a red field, and marks in blue and red are interspersed in the text in that column. There is a wide margin surrounding the text around all four sides of the sheet. The Roman numeral four, written as "IIII" alternating between red and blue strokes, appears at the top center.

artworks.title: Allegory of Vanity (Death Surprising a Woman)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 35.9 x 25.2 cm (14 1/8 x 9 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude person admiring their reflection in a large mirror. Their body is twisted as they reach up to touch their head, which is covered with a cloth. They have classical facial features with prominent eyebrows and a defined jawline. In the background, there is a skeletal figure holding an hourglass and a wheel, symbolizing the passage of time. Beside the person are a pair of wings, and in the corner, a column with a garland. The background shows an intricately detailed interior wall with a Latin phrase at the bottom and the artist's monogram in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: White Eagle and Crown of Poland
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines, shapes, and patterns. A large crown-like shape is at the top with eye-like elements below it. Curving lines, leaf-like forms, and floral motifs are present throughout, resembling blooming flowers. Vase-like and urn-like forms cradle bouquets in the lower section, surrounded by a border of small floral designs.

artworks.title: Christian with the Shield of Faith, Taking Leave of His Companions
artworks.medium: graphite, pen and ink, and watercolor
artworks.description: This is a painting of four ethereal figures walking together with a faint architectural background. The figures are posed gracefully, with flowing garments. The artist uses soft hues of pink, blue, and yellow. In the background, an outline of a grand structure emerges. The delicate application of color and line work creates an otherworldly atmosphere.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate title page. The central space is filled with elegant script, flanked by two seated figures resembling mythical creatures with human and animal features. These figures are integrated into a decorative frame with scroll-like patterns and elaborate structures. At the top, a figure with flowing hair is overlooked by two symmetrical candlesticks. The text in the center includes the title "BIZARIE di varie Figure di Giovanbattista Braccelli pittore fiorentino All'Ill.mo s. Don Pietro Medici 1624," suggesting it is a work by Giovanni Battista Braccelli dedicated to Don Pietro Medici, dated 1624. The drawing exhibits a baroque style focusing on intricate detailing and symmetry.

artworks.title: Dedication to Don Pietro Medici from "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic shield with decorative elements. The design features a shield in the center displaying six roundels, arranged in two groups of three. The shield is framed by a border that includes floral and scroll motifs. Above the shield are two cherubic figures interacting with the shield's top edge. On either side of the shield are weapons, flags, and a drum styled in an ornate manner. The inscription "S.DON PIETROMEDICI" appears below the shield. The image is detailed with lines and cross-hatching.

artworks.title: From "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: The image consists of various abstract shapes and lines. One shape on the left resembles a textured column with decorative elements. In the center, there is a box-like object with intricate embellishments. Wing-like extensions are on each side of the central object. To the right, another rectangular shape on slender legs is present. The composition suggests a collection of anthropomorphic figures and objects in a fantastical setting.

artworks.title: From "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two mythical figures. The image shows two human-like figures with elaborate, nature-inspired costumes. The figure on the left appears composed of swirling lines and tendrils, with outstretched arms and expressive gestures. The figure on the right is adorned with organic elements such as leaves, shells, and possibly feathers, with an intricately detailed garment giving it a majestic appearance. The figures are positioned in a space delineated by a simple ground line. The drawing is monochromatic, with intricate line work and shading suggesting texture and depth in both figures.

artworks.title: From "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: The image shows two figures made of rectangular and linear shapes. The design is abstract, resembling mechanical or geometric forms. Each figure stands in a dynamic pose, one holding a long, thin object over its shoulder, while the other holds a curving line. The figures may be reminiscent of articulated robots or mannequins with segmented limbs and torsos.

artworks.title: From "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures positioned side by side. The figure on the left is standing with one hand on their hip and the other arm extended outward, wearing an intricately designed outfit resembling medieval armor and a pointed hat with a tassel. The figure's hair is long and flows beneath the hat. The figure on the right is in a dynamic pose, with both arms raised above their head, wearing similar armor with circular embellishments on the chest area and long, unfurled hair. Each figure is depicted against a simple background with faint horizontal lines indicating a ground surface. The image appears to be an engraving on a lightly textured paper with visible wear and discoloration around the edges.

artworks.title: From "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: The image shows angular and curvilinear lines forming two humanoid figures against a plain background. Geometric shapes like rectangles and triangles are incorporated with flowing lines resembling hair or motion. The figure on the left raises an arm while the figure on the right appears to stride forward.

artworks.title: From "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: The image depicts sharp, angular lines and geometric shapes forming two figures in dynamic poses. The abstract design conveys movement, with zigzag patterns and interconnected polygons outlining figures resembling human dancers. The figures have flowing hair and outstretched limbs, invoking the image of someone performing a dance.

artworks.title: From "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: The image shows a composition of geometric shapes forming two abstract figures. Triangles, diamonds, and rectangles make up the figures. The figure on the left has a hat with a feather and a hand on the hip. The figure on the right has long pointed lines extending from its head and appears to raise its arm. The figures evoke a sense of character and interaction, reminiscent of a theatrical performance.

artworks.title: From "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: The image displays multiple diamond shapes arranged to form two humanoid figures. The overlapping diamonds create a quilt-like pattern. One figure extends an arm holding a cluster while the other reaches out towards it. Both figures stand on a lightly sketched horizon line, suggesting an interaction between two abstract beings.

artworks.title: From "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: The image shows swirling lines forming two abstract humanoid figures in dynamic poses, one holding a small serpent-like creature. The figures stand on a simple line suggesting a ground plane.

artworks.title: From "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two abstract humanoid forms interacting. The figures have elongated limbs and distinctive features. The figure on the left has swirling patterns, resembling twisting vines or smoke. The figure on the right has a muscular anatomy with defined lines accentuating the musculature. The figures face each other in a minimalist space with subtle horizontal lines suggesting a ground, implying a connection or interaction.

artworks.title: From "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: The image shows two figures wearing elaborate armor. The figure on the left is in profile, holding arrows or spears over their shoulder with their right hand. The figure on the right faces forward, with their upper body slightly turned towards the left figure. Both figures wear plumed helmets and have swords visible. The background is plain with a dotted line indicating a floor or ground.

artworks.title: From "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two skeletons interacting. The image shows two skeletal figures standing and engaging with each other. The skeleton on the left wears a cap and a decorated outfit, while holding a vessel or jar, reaching out to the skeleton on the right. The figure on the right stands with one arm raised to its head. Both skeletons have exaggerated joints and elongated limbs, giving them a surreal appearance. The background is plain, focusing on the interaction between the skeletal figures.

artworks.title: From "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two abstract humanoid figures made from various objects. Each figure is composed of assembled objects, resembling human forms with a whimsical and surreal quality. The figure on the left has a body shaped like a can, with geometric shapes indicating limbs and a shovel for one leg and another tool for its other leg. The figure on the right has scissors as legs and a bowl held in one hand, draped in a textured material simulating clothing. Both figures have square heads with simple facial features, contributing to the mechanical appearance. The background is plain, directing attention to the unique combinations forming these characters. The use of cross-hatching and etching gives depth and texture, enhancing the object's metallic and rigid feel.

artworks.title: From "Bizzarie di varie Figure"
artworks.description: The image shows two figures made of geometric shapes, mainly rectangles and squares with intersecting lines. The figures resemble robotic or armored forms, appearing as if constructed from blocks. Each figure holds a bird, one on an arm and the other on a shoulder. One of the figures holds a long spear-like object.
